<h1 id="学习资源">学习资源</h1>
<h2 id="经典教材">经典教材</h2>
<p><a href="https://book.douban.com/subject/37331056/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><strong>《大模型算法：强化学习、微调与对齐》</strong></a></p>
<ul>
<li>原创 100+ 架构图，系统讲解大模型、强化学习，涵盖：LLM / VLM 等大模型原理、训练算法（RL、RLHF、GRPO、DPO、SFT 与 CoT 蒸馏等）、效果优化与 RAG 等。</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/changyeyu/LLM-RL-Visualized" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/changyeyu/LLM-RL-Visualized</a> | 1.5k<strong>⭐</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="1" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3719074/202511/3719074-20251103215851632-1119318902.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>Deep Reinforcement Learning Hands-On</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>以简洁易懂的方式讲解深度强化学习，结合 PyTorch 等现代库，通过游戏、股票交易等多样化应用案例，帮助读者从基础逐步掌握到高级概念。</li>
<li>v1版代码：<a href="https://github.com/PacktPublishing/Deep-Reinforcement-Learning-Hands-On" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/PacktPublishing/Deep-Reinforcement-Learning-Hands-On</a> | 3k<strong>⭐</strong></li>
<li>v2版代码：<a href="https://github.com/PacktPublishing/Deep-Reinforcement-Learning-Hands-On-Second-Edition" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/PacktPublishing/Deep-Reinforcement-Learning-Hands-On-Second-Edition</a> | 1.3k<strong>⭐</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="2" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3719074/202511/3719074-20251103215907443-904271525.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>强化学习之父Richard sutton的书，强化学习圣经级的入门书籍</li>
<li>第一版: <a href="http://incompleteideas.net/book/first/the-book.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://incompleteideas.net/book/first/the-book.html</a></li>
<li>翻译版: <a href="https://rl.qiwihui.com/zh-cn/latest/index.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://rl.qiwihui.com/zh-cn/latest/index.html</a></li>
<li>第二版: <a href="http://incompleteideas.net/book/the-book.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://incompleteideas.net/book/the-book.html</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/ShangtongZhang/reinforcement-learning-an-introduction" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/ShangtongZhang/reinforcement-learning-an-introduction</a> | 14.4k<strong>⭐</strong></li>
<li>UCL课程：<a href="https://dennybritz.com/posts/wildml/learning-reinforcement-learning/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://dennybritz.com/posts/wildml/learning-reinforcement-learning/</a>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/dennybritz/reinforcement-learning" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/dennybritz/reinforcement-learning</a> | 21.7k<strong>⭐</strong></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="3" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3719074/202511/3719074-20251103215914645-1308675095.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>动手学强化学习</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>本书一共分为三个部分，分别为动手学习基础篇、动手学习进阶篇和动手学习前沿篇。基础篇关注于 tabular 场景下的 RL，即状态和动作空间都是有限的；进阶篇的内容突破这一限制，考虑连续的状态或动作，此时我们会使用到神经网络。最后，在前沿篇我们会介绍强化学习领域一些有趣的方向，以及相对应的前沿算法</li>
<li><a href="https://link.zhihu.com/?target=https%3A//hrl.boyuai.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">动手学强化学习</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV126XAYoEzp/?spm_id_from=333.337.search-card.all.click&amp;vd_source=4b9ce8a08a480be5e20e6e8138c3124f" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">B站视频链接</a></li>
<li><a href="https://link.zhihu.com/?target=https%3A//github.com/boyu-ai/Hands-on-RL" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/boyu-ai/Hands-on-RL</a> | 4.1k <strong>⭐</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="4" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3719074/202511/3719074-20251103215921010-10276034.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>蘑菇书EasyRL</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>整理了李宏毅老师的《深度强化学习》中文视频、周博磊老师的《强化学习纲要》、李科浇老师的《世界冠军带你从零实践强化学习》以及多个强化学习的经典资料。包含RL经典论文解读，见github地址。</li>
<li><a href="https://link.zhihu.com/?target=https%3A//datawhalechina.github.io/easy-rl/%23/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">蘑菇书EasyRL</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/datawhalechina/easy-rl" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/datawhalechina/easy-rl</a> | 12.8k <strong>⭐</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><a href="https://pcnzmyb3bo4o.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=MjEzZDhmNWNjNWVlODkyNGJmNTliY2VmOGU4M2ZkNmZfWmNEY2xxUk5xblU1RjlBYTlkNG9MYnBtQ2h3a1hZS25fVG9rZW46VG9UcWJNbUV3bzF2NmZ4NzQyYWNqU1h5bjFjXzE3NjIxNjMyNTI6MTc2MjE2Njg1Ml9WNA" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"></a></p>
<h2 id="博客">博客</h2>
<p><strong>OpenAI Spinning Up</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>OpenAI 的 Spinning Up 仓库是一个深度学习强化学习的教育资源，包含入门介绍、论文列表、关键算法的独立实现及练习等内容</li>
<li><a href="https://spinningup.openai.com/en/latest/index.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://spinningup.openai.com/en/latest/index.html</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/openai/spinningup" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/openai/spinningup</a> | 11.3k<strong>⭐</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><a href="http://karpathy.github.io/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><strong>Andrej Karpathy blog</strong></a></p>
<ul>
<li>应用强化学习的策略梯度算法的乒乓球游戏，Andrej Karpathy通过130行代码实现的，帮助理解强化学习算法。</li>
<li><a href="http://karpathy.github.io/2016/05/31/rl/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Deep Reinforcement Learning: Pong from Pixels</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/llSourcell/Policy_Gradients_to_beat_Pong" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/llSourcell/Policy_Gradients_to_beat_Pong</a> | 11.3k<strong>⭐</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>小鸟FlappyBird游戏+DQN算法</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>该项目通过卷积神经网络+<a href="https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=335859807&amp;content_type=Answer&amp;match_order=1&amp;q=Q-learning%E7%AE%97%E6%B3%95&amp;zhida_source=entity" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Q-learning算法</a>，利用Keras框架共210行代码实现了让程序自己学习如何玩耍FlappyBird</li>
<li><a href="https://www.jianshu.com/p/3ba69493f020" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.jianshu.com/p/3ba69493f020</a></li>
</ul>

<h2 id="强化学习仿真环境legged-gym的初步使用训练一个二阶倒立摆">强化学习仿真环境Legged Gym的初步使用——训练一个二阶倒立摆</h2>
<p><a href="https://blog.zzshub.cn/2024/06/25/DRL_LeggedgymCartpole2/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://blog.zzshub.cn/2024/06/25/DRL_LeggedgymCartpole2/</a></p>
<p>本篇教程大致介绍 Legged Gym 的结构，使用方法，并以一个二阶倒立摆为例来完成一次实际的强化学习训练。适合强化学习初学者复现。</p>
<p>文档包含 ①强化学习基本概念 ②Legged Gym 环境安装 ③Legged Gym 代码结构介绍 ④二阶倒立摆训练项目代码解读。</p>
<h2 id="开发工具">开发工具</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>序号</th>
<th>工具名称</th>
<th>工具描述</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>1</strong></td>
<td><strong>Gymnasium开源工具包</strong></td>
<td><a href="https://gymnasium.farama.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">官网介绍</a> 包含详细介绍、使用教程、api汇总等Gymnasium 是强化学习领域的一个开源工具包，用于开发和比较强化学习算法。它最初是OpenAI Gym 的延续，提供了标准化的 API 和多样化的环境，方便研究人员和开发者训练.测试和评估智能体(Agent)的表现。这是一个通用强化学习环境库，适用于广泛的RL任务Gymnasium是一个轻量级的工具包，主要基于CPU运行，适合学术研究和小规模实验。<strong>Gymnasium的学习、使用相关经验贴</strong><a href="https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/876047971" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">【强化学习】Gymnasium库的介绍和使用</a><a href="https://blog.csdn.net/qq_44154915/article/details/134112242" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">如何开心地入门gym(gymnasium)</a></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2</td>
<td><strong>RLlib（Ray）</strong></td>
<td>Ray是UCBerkeley RISELab开发的分布式编程框架，其中的RLlib提供了很多的强化学习算法支持，支持常见的PPO、SAC、TD3、IMPALA、DQN等算法。提供了不错的分布式支持。后端支持：TensorFlow + PyTorchgithub：<a href="https://github.com/ray-project/ray" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/ray-project/ray</a></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>3</strong></td>
<td><strong>Gym Retro</strong></td>
<td>大约18年，OpenAI 发布了完整版游戏强化学习研究平台——Gym Retro。游戏数量从大约 70 个雅达利和 30 个世嘉游戏增加到了1000多个游戏，其中包括对Game boy等各种模拟器的支持。此外，OpenAI 还将发布用于向 Gym 平台添加新游戏的工具。Github: <a href="https://github.com/openai/retro/tree/develop" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/openai/retro/tree/develop</a></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

</div>
